paper.$description: Default page background. Warm off-white with a hint of rose.

surface.$description: Elevated surface background for cards, panels, and overlays.

ink.$description: Primary text and foreground colour. Near-black with a teal undertone.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, captions, and placeholder content.

ink-faint.$description: Tertiary text for metadata and timestamps.

blue.$description: Primary brand accent. Used for links, focus rings, and CTAs.

cyan.$description: Secondary accent for highlights, selection backgrounds, and badges.

cyan-soft.$description: Pale cyan for subtle highlighted regions and active states.

success.$description: Positive state colour for confirmations and success banners.

warning.$description: Cautionary state colour for warnings and validation hints.

fail.$description: Error state colour for destructive actions and error messages.

rule.$description: Hairline border and divider colour. Semi-transparent ink.

spacing.$description: Spacing scale based on a 4px grid with a power-of-two progression.

display.$description: Display and heading typeface. Geometric grotesque with optical sizing.

sans.$description: Body and UI typeface. Designed for readability and accessibility.

fontSize.$description: Font size scale. Body text starts at md (17px).

normal.$description: Default line height for body text. Generous for readability.

caps.$description: Wide tracking for uppercase labels and captions.

borderRadius.$description: Vantra uses square corners exclusively. Border radius is 0 everywhere.

full.$description: Only used for avatars and pill badges.

shadow.$description: Minimal shadow scale. Vantra prefers borders over elevation.

hover.$description: Hover overlay opacity on interactive surfaces.

focus.$description: Focus ring tokens for keyboard navigation. Two-tone ring: accent outline + paper halo.

ring-color.$description: Focus ring colour. Matches the blue accent.

halo-color.$description: Background halo behind the focus ring for contrast.

motion.$description: Animation durations and easings. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

enter.$description: Ease-out for elements entering the viewport.

exit.$description: Ease-in for elements leaving the viewport.

zIndex.$description: Stacking order for layered UI. Increments of 100.
